name: facets
x-cookwala-note: Registry of household and device context facts (RFC-0001). privacy is the default class (raise only); travel says whether the raw fact may leave the home: never, only as a derived constraint, or as a selective disclosure after consent. derivesTo lists the DerivedConstraint types the fact may produce; profiles/household/recipient-roles.json says which types each recipient role may receive. Facts from inferred sources are never used for safety decisions.
